mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing amitriptyline metabolism and increasing tricyclic antidepressant levels; additive CNS depression may occur.
action: Monitor for increased amitriptyline adverse effects (sedation, anticholinergic symptoms, arrhythmias); consider amitriptyline dose reduction or use alternative antidepressant if clinically feasible.
